name: Ingrid Solberg
headline: 34, owner of a smoked-fish company, Bergen
description: Ingrid owns a nine-person smoked-fish business outside Bergen and used her inheritance to buy the processing loft. She also manages her father's in-home caregivers, who rotate through shifts, and reviews their logs every night. She is preparing for a national food competition and sends weekly spreadsheets of rival pricing to her two employees.
